brief: This is a short email note from Tony Pasquariello announcing Goldman Sachs' annual AI theme check-in, co-authored with George Lee, co-head of the Goldman Sachs Global Institute, published 7 Nov 2026. The note itself does not argue a thesis or state figures; it lists the topics the linked discussion covers: the setup for the AI theme following the midterm elections, the financing required to support AI capex growth, non-traditional ROIC (return on invested capital) frameworks for evaluating AI investment, and the global AI race among countries and companies. The substantive analysis, data, and calls referenced by these topics live in the linked Marquee content, not in the extracted text, so no claims, numbers, levels, or directional calls are present here to report.
